critical_code_review_comments: index.css rule `button { border-radius: 9999px }` is a broad selector — it also forces 50px radius on any 3rd-party/internal icon-only buttons. Confirmed visually no issues in the 6 pages tested, but note for future phases.

The `.glass-nav .text-white { color: #181818 }` override relies on existing Tailwind `text-white` utilities in Header.tsx. If future edits remove those classes, text-color flip will break. Consider migrating to semantic CSS variables in Phase 2.

`div.bg-white[class*='rounded-'][class*='border']` etc. card-targeting rule is broad — it will also glass-ify non-hero white surfaces the designer may not have intended. Fine for Phase 1 but should be narrowed via an explicit .glass-card class in later phases.
Events page hero does not have hero-orbs wrapper — confirm with designer if orbs should extend to /events hero as well.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Phase 1 glassmorphism visually verified. If Phase 2 is requested, focus on: (1) narrowing the global `button { border-radius: 9999px }` to scoped selectors; (2) confirming event cards and ticket detail pages still look correct with glass treatment; (3) check dark-mode behavior (currently not tested as app is light-mode only per PRD).
